comment: Going back over paint in one noise stroke thickens it. On a white 1200 by 700 document, in black and with randomness at nought, Grain Round paints one pass from x 150 to 530 at y 180 on the left and, on the right, one stroke that scrubs from x 670 to 1050 at the same y and back three times over, every point at a press of 0.5, each through the door's stroke step on the tool's own route in document space. Bristle Flat paints the same pair at y 520. A look of the whole document follows, to judge how much a scrub thickens the paint beside one pass, and whether a straight pass still shows no dab count.
